2  Adelie Torgersen           39.5          17.4               186        3800

     sex year
1   male 2007
2 female 2007

4   <NA> 2007
5 female 2007
6   male 2007



mean(penguin_data$flipper_length_mm[penguin_data$species == "Adelie"], na.rm = TRUE)

[1] 189.9536

mean(penguin_data$flipper_length_mm[penguin_data$species == "Chinstrap"], na.rm = TRUE)

[1] 195.8235

mean(penguin_data$flipper_length_mm[penguin_data$species == "Gentoo"], na.rm = TRUE)

[1] 217.187



barplot(tapply(penguin_data$flipper_length_mm, penguin_data$species, mean, na.rm = TRUE))







Figure 1: Average flipper length by species.





Gentoo penguins have the longest average flippers, followed by Chinstrap penguins and then Adelie penguins.
